sections.title: Levels
sections.note: 32 levels, four per area. The four can be played in any order; the fourth opens the next areas.

items.name: Deku Forest
items.howTo: Items: 3 × Bow.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Blob Jelly, 1 × Armos Spirit

items.name: Buzz Blob Cave
items.howTo: Items: 3 × Bow. Mini-boss: Electric Blob King.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Blob Jelly, 1 × Tektite Shell

items.name: Moblin Base
items.howTo: Items: 2 × Bow, Bombs.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Armos Spirit, 1 × Sweet Shroom

items.name: Forest Temple
items.howTo: Items: Bow, 2 × Bombs. Boss: Margoma.
items.reward: Lady's Glasses (first clear only). End chests: 2 × Tektite Shell, 1 × Blin Bling
items.notes: Clearing it opens Riverside, Volcano and Ice Cavern, and the 12 Woodlands challenges.

items.name: Secret Fortress
items.howTo: Items: 3 × Water Rod.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Fresh Kelp, 1 × Zora Scale

items.name: Abyss of Agony
items.howTo: Items: Bow, 2 × Water Rod. Mini-boss: Electric Blob Queen.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Fresh Kelp, 1 × Hytopian Silk

items.name: Cove of Transition
items.howTo: Items: 3 × Gripshot.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Zora Scale, 1 × Aqua Crown

items.name: Water Temple
items.howTo: Items: Water Rod, 2 × Gripshot. Boss: Arrghus.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Hytopian Silk, 1 × Octorok Sucker
items.notes: Clearing it opens the 12 Riverside challenges. The Fortress needs all three of the Water, Fire and Ice Temples.

items.name: Blazing Trail
items.howTo: Items: 3 × Boomerang.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Goron Ore, 1 × Monster Guts

items.name: Hinox Mine
items.howTo: Items: Bow, 2 × Boomerang. Mini-boss: Hinox Brothers.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Goron Ore, 1 × Demon Fossil

items.name: Den of Flames
items.howTo: Items: Boomerang, 2 × Gust Jar.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Monster Guts, 1 × Rugged Horn

items.name: Fire Temple
items.howTo: Items: Bow, Boomerang, Gust Jar. Boss: Moldorm.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Demon Fossil, 1 × Kodongo Tail
items.notes: Clearing it opens the 12 Volcano challenges. The Fortress needs all three of the Water, Fire and Ice Temples.

items.name: Frozen Plateau
items.howTo: Items: 3 × Fire Gloves.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Fluffy Fuzz, 1 × Tiny Snowflake

items.name: Snowball Ravine
items.howTo: Items: Boomerang, 2 × Fire Gloves. Mini-boss: Freezlord.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Fluffy Fuzz, 1 × Serpent Fangs

items.name: Silver Shrine
items.howTo: Items: 3 × Magic Hammer.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Tiny Snowflake, 1 × Crimson Shell

items.name: Ice Temple
items.howTo: Items: Fire Gloves, 2 × Magic Hammer. Boss: Blizzagia.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Serpent Fangs, 1 × Freezard Water
items.notes: Clearing it opens the 12 Ice Cavern challenges. The Fortress needs all three of the Water, Fire and Ice Temples.

items.name: Sealed Gateway
items.howTo: Items: 2 × Boomerang, Gust Jar.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Stiff Puff, 1 × Silver Thread

items.name: Bomb Storage
items.howTo: Items: Bombs, 2 × Gust Jar. Mini-boss: Hinox Brothers (rematch).
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Stiff Puff, 1 × Royal Ring
items.notes: Zelda Wiki lists the Hinox Brothers as the Fortress mini-boss, fought again here.

items.name: Training Ground
items.howTo: Items: Bow, Gripshot, Gust Jar.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Silver Thread, 1 × Antique Coin

items.name: The Lady's Lair
items.howTo: Items: Gripshot, Boomerang, Gust Jar. Boss: The Lady's Pets.
items.reward: Lady's Collar (first clear only). End chests: 2 × Royal Ring, 1 × Fancy Fabric
items.notes: The Lady's three Pets; Prima's walkthrough fights Margoma, Arrghus and Moldorm again here. Clearing it opens The Dunes, The Ruins and the 12 Fortress challenges.

items.name: Infinity Dunes
items.howTo: Items: Water Rod, 2 × Gust Jar.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Palm Cone, 1 × Ancient Fin

items.name: Stone Corridors
items.howTo: Items: Gripshot, Boomerang, Gust Jar. Mini-boss: Vulture Vizier.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Palm Cone, 1 × Vintage Linen

items.name: Gibdo Mausoleum
items.howTo: Items: Gripshot, Gust Jar, Fire Gloves.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Ancient Fin, 1 × Gibdo Bandage

items.name: Desert Temple
items.howTo: Items: Boomerang, 2 × Magic Hammer. Boss: Stalchampion.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Vintage Linen, 1 × Stal Skull
items.notes: Clearing it opens the 12 Dunes challenges. The Sky Realm needs both the Desert and Grim Temples.

items.name: Illusory Mansion
items.howTo: Items: 3 × Boomerang.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Carrumpkin, 1 × Mystery Extract

items.name: Palace Noir
items.howTo: Items: Bow, Gust Jar, Fire Gloves. Mini-boss: Grim Repoe.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Carrumpkin, 1 × Spider Silk Lace

items.name: Lone Labyrinth
items.howTo: Items: Gripshot, Gust Jar, Fire Gloves.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Mystery Extract, 1 × Poe Soul

items.name: Grim Temple
items.howTo: Items: Gripshot, Boomerang, Fire Gloves. Boss: Prismantus.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Spider Silk Lace, 1 × Twisted Twig
items.notes: Clearing it opens the 12 Ruins challenges. The Sky Realm needs both the Desert and Grim Temples.

items.name: Floating Garden
items.howTo: Items: Bow, Bombs, Gripshot.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Cucco Feathers, 1 × Carmine Pearl

items.name: Deception Castle
items.howTo: Items: 2 × Gripshot, Gust Jar. Mini-boss: Gigaleon.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Cucco Feathers, 1 × Sky Dragon Tail

items.name: Dragon Citadel
items.howTo: Items: Water Rod, Boomerang, Magic Hammer.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Carmine Pearl, 1 × Pretty Plume

items.name: Sky Temple
items.howTo: Items: all eight wait on pedestals; each Link picks one. Boss: Lady Maud (The Lady).
items.reward: Lady's Parasol (first clear only). End chests: 2 × Sky Dragon Tail, 1 × Mock Fairy
items.notes: The item pedestals return in Stages 2 and 3, so the Links can swap. With the Lady's Glasses, Collar and Parasol, Madame Couture makes the Lady's Ensemble, which lifts Princess Styla's curse and ends the story. Clearing it opens the 12 Sky Realm challenges.

sections.title: Drablands Challenges
sections.note: Three per level. All 12 in an area open at once when its fourth level is cleared.

items.name: Fewer Heart Containers!
items.howTo: Clear the level with five fewer Heart Containers.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Blob Jelly, 1 × Tektite Shell
items.notes: Challenge 1 of 3 in the level's list. Outfits that add Heart Containers (Jack of Hearts, Queen of Hearts, Lady's Ensemble) help.

items.name: Clear within the time limit!
items.howTo: Clear the level before the timer runs out. Small hourglasses add 5 seconds, big ones 20; running out is a Game Over.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Armos Spirit, 1 × Sweet Shroom
items.notes: Challenge 2 of 3 in the level's list. Linebeck's Uniform adds 10 seconds per Link wearing it.

items.name: Guard the orb!
items.howTo: Carry the glowing orb through each stage and throw it into the pedestal by the gateway. Staying outside its light for long hurts.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Tektite Shell, 1 × Blin Bling
items.notes: Challenge 3 of 3 in the level's list.

items.name: Pop all balloons!
items.howTo: Pop every red balloon in each stage before the gateway opens.
items.reward: End chests: 2 × Armos Spirit, 1 × Sweet Shroom

sections.title: King Tuft's Rewards
sections.note: One gold material per area for clearing its 12 challenges, and a Gold Rupee for the full list.

items.name: Supple Leaf
items.howTo: Clear all 12 Woodlands challenges, then talk to King Tuft.
items.reward: Supple Leaf
items.notes: A gold material for the Cacto Clothes. Otherwise only won in the Woodlands Coliseum arena, or (since Ver. 2.1.0) given by the Street Merchant for Hero Points.

items.howTo: Fill all 128 marks on the Completion List (32 levels and 96 challenges), then talk to King Tuft.
items.reward: Gold Rupee (300 Rupees)
items.notes: A single-player level where you skipped a stage isn't marked on the list, though the level select shows it cleared. Zelda Wiki is the only source checked that gives this reward.
